{{Quote|Our people need battle to find out what we are.|Torian Cadera|<ref name="TOR:LttF">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Torian Cadera|Looking to the Future}}</ref>}}
'''Torian Cadera''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior and a son of [[Mandalore the Vindicated]]'s rebellious opponent, [[Jicoln Cadera]]. Seeking to reclaim the honor of his clan, Torian teamed up with the [[Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]] to track and take down his father on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], joining with the Hunter's crew after the deed was done. Torian traveled with the Hunter for years, being briefly kidnapped by [[GenoHaradan]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. After the Champion disappeared early in the [[Eternal Empire conquest]], Torian answered the call of the new [[Mandalore the Avenger]] and eventually became the chieftain of [[Clan Cadera]] as its numbers dwindled. Joining other Mandalorians under the wing of the new [[Mandalore (title)|Mand'alor]], Torian assisted [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] in opposing [[Zakuul]] in a [[Raid on Darvannis|raid]] on the [[Darvannis factory]], formally joining the Alliance as [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla's]] representative afterwards. As part of the ongoing [[war against Zakuul]] Torian led a team of Mandalorian Commandos during the [[Invasion of Voss]], helping to liberate the city of [[Voss-Ka]]. While reclaiming the ''[[Gravestone]]'' from the Eternal Empress [[Vaylin]], Torian and other Alliance personnel were trapped by [[ARIES]] on the artificial world of [[Iokath]] and worked together to escape before the world was covered by a radiation pulse. When Vaylin launched an [[assault on Odessen]] where the [[Alliance base]] was located, Torian led a group of Mandalorian Commandos to assist [[Bey'wan Aygo]], until their position was overrun, with Torian as the last one standing. The Alliance Commander was forced to choose between rescuing either Torian or the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] escape artist [[Vette]], with the second choice being captured and later killed by Vaylin.

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|Artus swore he'd slaughter my boy at his mother's breast. He swore it when he left me here.|Jicoln Cadera|<ref name="TOR:HoG" />}}
Torian was born on the<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Mandalorian stronghold world<ref name="TOR:CV">{{TORcite|type=codex|Clan Varad}}</ref> of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> to [[Jicoln Cadera]],<ref name="TOR:AFM" /> leader of the [[Crusader's schism]]<ref name="TOR:Kinship">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Torian Cadera|Kinship}}</ref> and an opponent of [[Mandalore the Vindicated]].<ref name="TOR:AFM" /> All his life, Torian dedicated himself to overcome the stigma of being the son of a traitor, but the shadow of his father always seemed to weigh on him in the eyes of the other [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]. As a consequence of the constant reminder of his clan's shame among his peers, Torian adhered to the Mandalorian codes of honor and traditions with more devotion than many warriors twice his age.<ref name="TOR:TC" /> He always strove to prove his loyalty to [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="TOR:HoG" /> During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Torian fought and traveled with his people, fighting with [[Clan Ordo]] on [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] to destroy a weapon's factory, being forced to face snipers and mines on the way. Things become trouble once they discovered resistance fighters hiding among the workers. They were able to evacuate as many civilians as they could before destroying the factory with [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]].<ref name="TOR:WS">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Torian Cadera|War Stories}}</ref>

===The honor of Clan Cadera===
{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
{{Quote|It's really you... Artus knows how to put the crowning irony on a vendetta.|Jicoln Cadera, to Torian|<ref name="TOR:HoG" />}}
[[File:Torian_Cadera.png|thumb|right|250px|Torian prepares to execute his father.]]
In [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|2}} The hunt for Akure takes place at the very beginning of Act II.</ref> Torian traveled to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] capital of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] to slay a deadly [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] [[Akure]] alongside several other clans. At the same time, the latest [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion]] of the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] was dispatched by [[Mandalore the Vindicated]] to slay the Sithspawn and succeeded in his task.<ref name="TOR:THoD">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Heart of Darkness|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>

Torian later found out that his traitorous father was in hiding on the planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and, motivated to cleansing his clan of his father's dishonor, traveled to Taris where under the command of [[Vorten Fett]] he went on to search for and kill his father. While on his mission, Torian again ran into the Champion, who was also searching for Jicoln to claim his bounty on the [[Blacklist]].<ref name="TOR:AFM" /> Together, Torian and the Champion tracked down Jicoln to his hideout and eventually confronted him. Defeated, Jicoln shared a few words with his son before Torian [[Death/Legends|killed]] him, reclaiming his clan's honor.<ref name="TOR:HoG" />

===Travels with the Hunter===
{{Quote|What sort of jobs are coming up? Hunting? Mercenary work?|Torian Cadera|<ref name="TOR:LttF" />}}
[[File:Torian.png|thumb|left|200px|Torian Cadera during his travels with the Hunter]]
Torian asked the Champion to join their crew,<ref name="TOR:HoG" /> claiming another Blacklist bounty, before his new friend was put at the top of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] Most Wanted list. With the entire [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] gunning for them, [[Gault Rennow]] suggested working for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], an idea that Torian was firmly opposed to. Before they could come to blows, Gault arguing that he's been dodging poetic justice since before Torian was born, they received a summons from the Sith Lord [[Darth Tormen]]. Tormen offered the Champion to work for him, promising revenge against the [[Battlemaster/Legends|Jedi Battlemaster]] [[Jun Seros (Jedi)|Jun Seros]] and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Dorian Janarus]] for targeting them in return. While the Champion was chasing [[Zale Barrows]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], Torian was captured by the secretive assassination guild the [[GenoHaradan]], being lured into a trap after receiving a meeting request from a friend. The Champion tracked the kidnappers to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], defeated all of the captors, and freed Torian.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

During the [[Eternal Empire conquest]] in [[3636 BBY]], the Champion went missing. The Champion's crew attempted to find their boss, even infiltrating the [[Spire (Zakuul)|Spire]] on [[Zakuul]], but unable to locate their target they eventually went broke, with their goals. Eventually, everyone but Torian and the slicer [[Mako (slicer)|Mako]] had left to pursue their own ends, leaving the two to resume bounty hunting by themselves, enduring the exile. When the new [[Mandalore the Avenger]] summoned all of the Mandalorian clans, Torian answered the call and left Mako on [[Carratos]], confident she could care for herself.<ref name="KotFE 14" /> Torian would rise up to become one of the new [[Mandalore]]'s top advisors<ref name="TOR:CC">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=codex|Clan Cadera}}</ref> alongside [[Khomo Fett]],<ref name="KotFE 14" /> eventually became the chieftain of [[Clan Cadera]] even though its numbers dwindled.<ref name="TOR:CC" />

===War against Zakuul===
====At Mandalore's Side====
{{Quote|Torian's chief of Clan Cadera and the best scout we've got. He'll show the way.|Shae Vizla|<ref name="KotFE 14" />}}
[[File:Torian_Cadera_on_Darvannis.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Torian Cadera on Darvannis]]
In [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|4.5}}</ref> [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]] received an offer from the new [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] opposing [[Zakuul]] to [[Raid on Darvannis|raid]] a [[Darvannis factory|weapons factory]] on [[Darvannis]], giving the Mandalorians a chance to both strike back against the [[Eternal Empire]] and rearm themselves after a prolonged campaign. Torian scouted the factory's perimeter defenses, reporting to Mandalore and [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]], whom he joined in capturing the perimeter guns and reprogramming them to target the factory. When [[Breyer Chorn]] reported that he and his men were being overrun by [[Skytrooper]]s, Torian stated that there was no honor and being killed by machines and attempted to target Chorn's location for an artillery strikes, killing the warriors along the droids, before being stopped by the Alliance Commander. The next day, Torian again joined the Commander in neutralizing the enemy forces at the Zakuulan listening post in preparation for the main assault. In there, he overheard the Commander's advisor [[Lana Beniko]] suggesting that the Mandalorians were animalistic in nature and that rearming them could potentially prove dangerous in the future.<ref name="KotFE 14" />

[[File:Torian_Cadera_KOTFE.png|thumb|left|200px|Torian joins Alliance Commander in capturing the perimeter guns.]]
With the factory's power stations taken overs by [[Clan Beroya]] and [[Clan Fett]] warriors, Shae Vizla gathered the warriors to rally them before the final assault. The main Mandalorian force moved into the factory to claim as many weapons as possible, while Torian accompanied the Commander on a mission to secure the [[GEMINI Prime]], the template for the [[GEMINI]] captains of the [[Eternal Fleet]]. Inside the factory, Torian revealed that he overheard the previous conversation between the Commander and Beniko and insisted that the Mandalorians were not animals, but warriors with a sense of honor. The Commander was successful in retrieving the PRIME and in the aftermath of the battle Torian requested the Mandalore to join the Alliance as her representative, which Shae Vizla granted.<ref name="KotFE 14" />

===Joining the Alliance===
{{Quote|Mandalorians are ready to follow the Alliance Commander into battle.|Torian Cadera|<ref name="KotET 1" />}}
[[File:TorianCaderaLeadsMandalorians-KOTET.png|thumb|right|250px|Torian Cadera leads the Mandalorian warriors during the battle of Voss.]]
Torian traveled to the [[Alliance base]] on [[Odessen]] and later was involved in its defense during the [[battle of Odessen]]. During the battle of Odessen Eternal Emperor [[Arcann]] was dethroned and his sister [[Vaylin]] claimed the [[Eternal Throne]].<ref name="KotFE 16">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=16}}</ref> When she launched an [[invasion of Voss]], Torian joined the Alliance's effort to liberate the planet led a team of Mandalorian Commandos against the enemy forces occupying the city of [[Voss-Ka]]. He also brought a Republic walker named [[Storm Rider]] that was used by the Commander and [[Theron Shan]] in traversing the path to the [[Shrine of Healing]].<ref name="KotET 1" />

[[File:Torian_Cadera_with_Alliance.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Torian Cadera with the Alliance]]
Torian later joined a team assembled by [[Theron Shan]] to assist Lana Beniko and the Alliance Commander in [[Assault on the Gravestone|retaking]] the ''[[Gravestone]]'' from Empress Vaylin and her forces. Theron's shuttle with Torian, [[Vette]], [[Kaliyo Djannis]] and [[Aric Jorgan]] inside landed inside the hangar of ''Gravestone'' just before [[SCORPIO]] took control of the vessel and launched it into hyperspace on a locked course. The ship emerged from hyperspace in [[Iokath system/Legends|Iokath system]], where Torian was the first to notice the entire Eternal Fleet around them. Vaylin and her remaining forces were found to be sabotaging the ship, with half the Alliance personnel spreading to stop the sabotage, while Torian remained with the other half to defend the ship's bridge. However, they were unable to stop Vaylin, who overpowered both Kaliyo Djannis and Aric Jorgan and took Torian and Vette hostage, but was unable to hurt them before a blinging white light engulfed the ship.<ref name="KotET 3">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=3}}</ref>

====Trapped on Iokath====
[[File:Torian_Cadera_2.png|thumb|right|250px|Torian Cadera finds Theron Shan and the Commander.]]
Torian awoke on the surface of the artificial world [[Iokath]], surrounded by hostile droids. [[Escape from Iokath|Fighting]] his way through them, Torian reached the [[Selruvian biome]] where he met the Alliance Commander. The two witnessed the Iokath droids attacking the [[Knights of Zakuul]], reasoning that both Alliance personnel and every person from aboard the Eternal Fleet were separated from each other and placed in scenarios that resembled combat simulations. Theron Shan managed contact the Commander and Torian, directing them to a structure called the [[Tributary]], where the rest of Alliance forced had gathered.<ref name="KotET 4">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=4}}</ref> There, their position came under attack from the droids again, forcing the group to look for another way out. The Commander and Vette went ahead, while the rest eventually followed, meeting them at a disabled [[colossus droid]]. There, Theron realized that even though he was unable to locate the ''Gravestone'', he could still use his implant to remotely pilot the Alliance shuttle that was left in its hangar.<ref name="KotET 5">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=5}}</ref>

[[File:Torian_Cadera_on_Iokath.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Torian Cadera on Iokath]]
However, before they could leave on the shuttle, SCORPIO contacted the group and revealed that [[ARIES]], the droid that controlled Iokath, raised an energy shield that would destroy any vessel attempting to leave. With ARIES re-charging the weapon that incapacitated them to begin with and promising to use it again on a lethal setting, the only way out was to stop ARIES. SCORPIO revealed that [[ARIES base]] was located in the southern hemisphere and Theron dropped off the Commander and Vette there to deal with ARIES, while the rest went to reclaim the ''Gravestone'' based on the shuttle's last known location. SCORPIO herself arrived to help the Commander defeat ARIES, however the capacitors on ARIES' weapon overloaded, threatening the cover the entire world with a pulse of deadly radiation, which the ''Gravestone'' just barely managed to escape to hyperspace to avoid.<ref name="KotET 5" />

====Endgame on Odessen====
[[File:Torian_Hologram.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Pinned down, Torian asks the Commander for assistance.]]
Vaylin later launched an [[assault on Odessen]], during which Torian led a group of Mandalorian Commandos to assist the forces of Admiral [[Bey'wan Aygo]], but their position was eventually overrun, with Torian left as the last one left standing. Torian made a call to the Alliance Commander for help, but the Commander was forced to choose between rescuing either him or Vette.<ref name="KotET 8">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=8}}</ref>

===Mandalorian Civil War===
[[File:Torian_Cadera_on_Ruhnuk.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Torian Cadera on Ruhnuk]]
When Shae Vizla went to confront her challengher [[Field Marshal/Legends|Field Marshal]] [[Heta Kol]] on [[Ruhnuk]], Torian Cadera joined [[Akaavi Spar]] as reinforcements for the Mandalore, Alliance Commander and [[Rass Ordo]]. Rass proposed that Shae and the Commander go to the [[Ruhnuk Communications Tower]] while the rest secure their position. The Commander stopped by to check up with Torian, who wondered if Shae was too quick to step from her role and chase down her prey. While the Mandalore and the Commander were gone, the others were attacked by a [[Clan Varad]] patrol but were able to fight them off and stood their ground. Akaavi and Torian went chasing after the stragglers, while Rass went towards the arena where the duel between Shae Vizla and Heta Kol was to take place. Heta Kol presented to the Hidden Chain the [[Clan Cadera banner]] and pronounced it a symbol of shame and treachery. She then burned the banner to signify the Hidden Chain's rejection of the Mandalore and her ways.<ref name="Ruhnuk">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Showdown on Ruhnuk|Ruhnuk}}</ref>

[[File:Torian_Cadera_and_the_banner.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Torian Cadera looks at the burnt banner of his clan.]]
The duel that followed soon turned into a full-blown battle between two Mandalorian factions, in which Torian fought close at the Mandalore's side. When Shae Vizla was incapacitated, Torian moved to assist the Commander against the Hidden Chain and make their way to Shae Vizla's position. The fight ended when Heta Kol and the Hidden Chain escaped the planet, after which [[Jekiah Ordo]] and the Commander helped Shae Vizla off Ruhnuk while Torian observed the destroyed banner of Clan Cadera in shock. Shae Vizla was taken to a medical facility and attended by medical droids, and Akaavi Spar and Torian Cadera stayed with her while Rass and Jekiah Ordo remained outside.<ref name="Ruhnuk" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I overheard your friend Lana. We're not animals, not predators. We're warriors.|Torian Cadera, to the Outlander|<ref name="KotFE 14" />}}
Having spent most of his life trying redeem his clan's honor from his father's betrayal of Mandalore the Vindicated, Torian upheld the [[Resol'nare|Mandalorian code]] and traditions more than most other younger Mandalorians. He embodied each of the Mandalorian ideals in hopes of striving the respect and honor of his fellow Mandalorians. Even when insulted by his fellow Mandalorians like [[Jogo]], he didn't react and remained calm about it.<ref name="TOR" />

[[File:Torian_Cadera_in_armor.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Torian Cadera's new armor during his time at Mandalore's side.]]
Torian expressed a strong dislike towards slavery, calling it like hunting mice. He had shown also to be against the idea of working for the Hutt clans, seeing it as going against his honor. When on the pirate hideout world of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], he was interested in the native people, the [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]], saying they would make good Mandalorians for their natural hunting skills.<ref name="TOR" />

When the Eternal Empire invaded the galaxy and the Grand Champion disappeared from the galaxy, Torian finally had his chance to prove his loyalty and duty to his people as he volunteered for the most dangerous of missions against the invaders, becoming very successful in these missions enough to earn the respect of Mandalore the Avenger. Like most Mandalorians, Torian Cadera was not afraid put his life on the line if it meant protecting his friends or completing a mission, having very little fear of death.<ref name="TOR" />

==Equipment==
Torian wore a lighter version of the [[TH-15B War Medic]] armor colored classic yellow and brown and a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]]. His armor had a wrist mounted blade and a [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]], while his primary weapon was either a [[techblade]] or a small [[techstaff]]. He was also often seen armed with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|Blaster pistol]] and/or a [[Sniper rifle/Legends|Sniper rifle]].<ref name="TOR" /> During the war against the Eternal Throne, Torian switched his armor to a unique set of dark blue [[Wasteland Raider armor|Mandalorian armor]] and the sniper rifle became his primary weapon.<ref name="KotFE 14" />

==Behind the scenes==
Torian Cadera appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a companion character for the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] class, voiced by [[Johnny Yong Bosch]]. Female bounty hunters can romance, and eventually marry, Torian. If not romanced in the base game, Torian may begin a romantic relationship with [[Mako (slicer)|Mako]], another of the Hunter's companions.<ref name="TOR" />

[[File:Torian_romance.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Female bounty hunters can romance Torian.]]
Torian later becomes a companion for characters of all classes following the completion of "Chapter XIV: Mandalore's Revenge" in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] expansion, where his weapon changes from a [[techstaff]] to a sniper rifle. Female bounty hunters can choose to continue their previous romance or break up with him.<ref name="KotFE 14" /> During [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] "Chapter VIII: End Times," the player has to choose between saving either Vette or Torian while letting the other one be killed by [[Vaylin]], neither of which is a Light or Dark side choice.<ref name="KotET 8" />

===Gameplay alternatives===
*During Act 2 of their class story on Taris, bounty hunters can either let Torian kill his father, which he approves of, or carbon-freeze and deliver him to [[Mandalore the Vindicated|Artus Lok]] alive instead.<ref name="TOR" />

*In [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Fallen Empire'']] "Chapter XIV: Mandalore's Revenge," Torian will suggest letting [[Breyer Chorn]] die in the artillery strike, while also taking out their attackers. The player can perform the action themselves, reject the notion or let Torian do the deed.<ref name="KotFE 14" />

*In ''Fallen Empire'' "Chapter XVI: The Battle of Odessen," player has to assign roles for Torian, [[Gault Rennow|Gault]], and Vette, telling one to stay behind on [[Odessen]], another to sabotage the weapons on the [[Eternal Flagship]], and the third to sabotage the Eternal Flagship's shields. In any choice, the ship is disabled successfully and the ground forces do not land on Odessen, with the only difference being in dialogue. Bounty hunters who romanced Torian will also share a brief moment with him before leaving to join the battle on the ''Gravestone''.<ref name="KotFE 16" />

[[File:Torian_Cadera_captured_by_Vaylin.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Torian Cadera captured by Vaylin]]
*In ''Fallen Empire'' "Chapter VIII: End Times," Torian and Vette will be overwhelmed by Eternal Empire forces, and player will have to choose whom to save. If player chooses to save Torian, he survives the battle and appears at the debriefing on Odessen later. If player chooses to save Vette, Torian will be captured by Empress [[Vaylin]], and she will kill him by snapping his neck in front of the player.<ref name="KotET 8" />

*In ''Fallen Empire'' "Chapter IX: The Eternal Throne," if Torian was saved in the previous chapter, he will appear on the ''Gravestone'' on the way to [[Zakuul]] and on Odessen at the proclamation of the [[Eternal Alliance]]. Bounty hunters who romanced Torian will share a moment with him before descending to the planet's surface.<ref name="KotET 9">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=9}}</ref>

*If Vette was saved instead of Torian, he will be completely absent from the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk]] despite the prominent role of [[Clan Cadera banner]].<ref name="Ruhnuk" />
